title: Four hundred miles
logline: Thursday. The drive home on the doughnut spare at fifty, the empty passenger seat, the blue haze. Four panels of the same seat with different things out the window.

panels.composition: Inside the Legacy: the empty passenger seat, the window beyond it: ferry water.

image.prompt: the inside of an old station wagon showing an empty passenger seat and through its window ferry water, a driver's elbow at the frame edge, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: Same seat. The window: interstate, trucks passing at seventy. The car at fifty.

image.prompt: the same empty passenger seat with trucks passing outside the window at speed

panels.composition: Same seat. The window: 101, the sea, dusk. The blue haze in the mirror.

image.prompt: the same empty passenger seat with a coastal highway and the sea at dusk outside the window and a faint blue exhaust haze in the mirror

panels.composition: Same seat. Night. The window: Gully's lot, and in the headlights, Maria holding the dog, who has seen the car.

characters.pose: holding the dog in the headlights
in her arms, seen the car

image.prompt: the same empty passenger seat at night with a woman holding an old dog in the car's headlights outside the window, the dog straining toward the car
image.notes: Cast note: Maria and the dog appear only through the window.

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Four panels of an empty seat. The dog in the headlights.
